name: RC Site Manager & Optimization
author: Rocket Comunicazione

sections.description:
RC Site Manager & Optimization is a comprehensive admin-only toolkit that transforms your WordPress backend into a powerful command center. Built specifically for professionals and agencies, this plugin seamlessly integrates with your favorite tools while adding advanced management capabilities.

🚀 Smart Integration System

The plugin automatically detects and enhances your existing tools, providing deep integration with:

WooCommerce Integration (v9.7.0+)
* Advanced order and customer management
* Yearly statistics and sales analytics
* Quick access to product management
* Custom reporting dashboard
* Performance optimized queries

SEO Tools Integration
* Rank Math (v1.0.240+) – Enhanced SEO management interface
* Yoast SEO (v25.0+) – Quick edit SEO data from custom panels
* Unified SEO dashboard for both plugins
* Bulk SEO operations
* Quick meta editing

WP Rocket Integration (v3.18+)
* Cache management from Site Manager dashboard
* Quick purge options
* Performance monitoring
* Integration with optimization workflows

Multilingual Support
* WPML (v4.7.0+) full compatibility
* Polylang (v4.7.0+) support
* Language-aware content management
* Multilingual SEO optimization

📊 Core Features

Centralized Dashboard
All your site management tools in one place. No more jumping between different admin pages. The dashboard provides instant access to all critical functions and real-time statistics.

Media Management
* Advanced media library tools
* Bulk operations
* Image optimization utilities
* Media usage tracking
* Attachment management

Top URL Tracking
Monitor your most important pages with custom tracking and analytics. Perfect for tracking landing pages, campaigns, and high-value content.

Utility Tools
Collection of powerful utilities for daily admin tasks:
* Database optimization
* Quick maintenance mode
* Bulk operations
* System information
* Performance monitoring

Plugin Management
Enhanced plugin management interface with additional controls and bulk operations not available in standard WordPress.

🔧 Technical Excellence

  • Performance First: Optimized code with minimal overhead
  • Security: Admin-only access with proper capability checks
  • Database: Custom tables for efficient data storage
  • AJAX Powered: Smooth, no-refresh operations
  • Fully Translatable: Complete internationalization support
  • Clean Code: Following WordPress coding standards

📈 Perfect For

  • Digital Agencies managing multiple client sites
  • E-commerce Stores running WooCommerce
  • Content Publishers needing advanced SEO tools
  • Developers wanting efficient admin workflows
  • Site Administrators seeking time-saving tools

🎯 Why Choose RC Site Manager?

  1. One Plugin, Multiple Solutions – Replaces several management plugins
  2. Intelligent Integration – Works with your existing tools, not against them
  3. Time Efficiency – Reduce admin time by up to 70%
  4. Professional Grade – Built by agency developers for real-world use
  5. Active Development – Regular updates and new features
  6. Clean Backend – No frontend impact, pure admin enhancement

💡 Smart Features

The plugin intelligently adapts based on your installed plugins:
* Shows WooCommerce tools only if WooCommerce is active
* Displays SEO features when Rank Math or Yoast is detected
* Enables WP Rocket panel when the plugin is installed
* Adjusts for WPML/Polylang when multilingual setup is detected

📋 Requirements

  • WordPress 6.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Administrator role access

Optional (for enhanced features):
* WooCommerce 9.7.0+
* WP Rocket 3.18+
* Rank Math SEO 1.0.240+ OR Yoast SEO 25.0+
* WPML 4.7.0+ OR Polylang 4.7.0+

🛠️ Developer Friendly

  • Extensive hooks and filters
  • Clean, documented code
  • Custom database tables with proper prefixing
  • AJAX endpoints for custom extensions
  • Translation-ready with POT files

👨‍💻 About Rocket Comunicazione

We are a digital agency specializing in WordPress and WooCommerce solutions. With years of experience managing complex sites, we built this plugin to solve real problems we face daily.

Website: rocketcomunicazione.com

Additional Information

Support: Visit our support forum

Contributing: Find us on GitHub

Privacy: This plugin does not collect any user data or connect to external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ‘Site Manager’ in your admin menu
  4. The plugin auto-detects installed integrations
  5. Start managing your site more efficiently!
sections.faq:
Which plugins does it integrate with?

Currently: WooCommerce, WP Rocket, Rank Math SEO, Yoast SEO, WPML, and Polylang. More integrations coming soon!

Can I use it without WooCommerce?

Absolutely! The plugin adapts to your setup. WooCommerce features only appear if WooCommerce is active.

Is it multisite compatible?

Currently optimized for single sites. Multisite support is planned for version 2.0.

Will it conflict with other admin tools?

No. We’ve tested compatibility with major admin enhancement plugins and themes.

Can multiple admins use it simultaneously?

Yes, all administrators can access and use the features concurrently.
